pooled_signal_fifth_fit_vs_four_term.description: MOD-20 unit 5: four-term base plus two predeclared interaction terms (flag_sum x move_toward_home, model_logit x move_available), LOSO 2020-2025, vs the four-term base on the same 1,503 games; -0.399 accuracy points, decisive 24-30 on 54. Line-move-toward-pick cell 0.001 pts, P+ 0.496, indistinguishable from zero.
pooled_signal_fifth_fit_vs_four_term.notes: Unit 5, predeclared before fitting: not a reparameterisation of the 7 composition flags. 2 looks this unit. Season-block bootstrap primary per predeclaration; week-block secondary agrees.

pooled_signal_fourth_fit_vs_four_term.classification_evidence: Interval [-2.58,-0.60] accuracy points sits entirely below zero (P+ 0.0005) against the four-term base; per AGENTS.md a resolved wrong sign with the whole interval on the wrong side of zero is an admissible closing ground for this one structural variant; the pooled family stays open for other structural variants, only this hierarchical fit is refuted
pooled_signal_fourth_fit_vs_four_term.description: MOD-20 unit 4: hierarchical/partial-pooling logistic (shared composition weight mu plus 7 per-flag deviations, shrinkage kappa selected by nested LOSO inner CV minimizing log loss) versus the four-term base, LOSO 2020-2025 opener grade, paired accuracy points
pooled_signal_fourth_fit_vs_four_term.notes: kappa (shrinkage strength on per-flag deviations) saturated the predeclared grid maximum (10000 of 1-10000) in all 6 outer LOSO folds and in the in-sample fit, meaning the nested inner-LOSO CV wanted more shrinkage than the grid offered, yet residual deviations still hurt OOS; decisive 29-52 on 81 of 1503 games; OOS accuracy hier 55.62% vs base 57.15% (model-only 53.36%); OOS Brier hier 0.2466 vs base 0.2454; OOS logloss hier 0.6865 vs base 0.6840; IS-OOS accuracy gap hier +0.86pt vs base +0.20pt; shared mu stable 0.23-0.29 across folds (matches base composition_flag_sum coefficient); per-flag deviations nonzero but modest (largest |mean| ~0.12 cold_visitor, ~0.09 division, ~0.08 bye); reliability table (5 quintile bins) shows hier OOS probabilities reasonably calibrated (predicted 0.397/0.460/0.488/0.529/0.603 vs observed 0.432/0.460/0.449/0.510/0.631); SE from 95pct bootstrap interval width / (2*1.96); grid not extended post-hoc after seeing the boundary hit, per no-in-sample-gate policy; 2 looks total for this unit
pooled_signal_fourth_fit_vs_four_term.plain_summary: Letting each situational flag drift from the group's average weight, with the drift shrunk by cross-validation, still did worse out of season than treating the flags as one simple sum -- the extra flexibility hurt, not helped.

pooled_signal_fourth_fit_vs_model_only.classification_evidence: Interval crosses zero (low -0.27); companion to the vs-four-term cell, which is the decision-relevant comparison and is resolved negative; no admissible closing ground applies here
pooled_signal_fourth_fit_vs_model_only.description: MOD-20 unit 4: hierarchical/partial-pooling logistic (shared composition weight mu plus 7 per-flag deviations, shrinkage kappa selected by nested LOSO inner CV) versus model-only, LOSO 2020-2025 opener grade, paired accuracy points
pooled_signal_fourth_fit_vs_model_only.notes: Decisive first: hier wins 271, model wins 237 on 508 decisive games of 1503. OOS accuracy hier 55.62% vs model-only 53.36%; OOS Brier hier 0.2466 vs model 0.2517; OOS logloss hier 0.6865 vs model 0.6969. SE from 95pct bootstrap interval width / (2*1.96). 2 looks total for this unit (shared with the vs-four-term cell).
pooled_signal_fourth_fit_vs_model_only.plain_summary: The hierarchical combined model still beats the model alone out of season, by about two games per hundred, but the four-term base beats it -- so this variant does not replace the simpler served fit.

pooled_signal_second_fit_vs_four_term.description: Second pooled fit (4 base terms + 8 easy columns) versus the four-term unit-1 fit, LOSO 2020-2025 opener grade, paired accuracy points
pooled_signal_second_fit_vs_four_term.notes: Decisive first: full wins 101, base wins 103 on 204 decisive games. Full OOS 55.82% vs base 55.95% (in-sample 57.88% vs 56.75%, gaps +2.06 vs +0.80); OOS Brier 0.2471 vs 0.2456 and log loss 0.6879 vs 0.6844 both favor base. Stable: flag_sum +0.260, move +0.220; tiny-population terms (low_total_div_home_dog 56 games, sept_heat 12 games) unstable. SE approximated from 90pct interval width. 8 of 9 easy candidates assembled; roof_state dropped (needs new snapshot history). 9 looks.
pooled_signal_second_fit_vs_four_term.plain_summary: Growing the combined model from 4 terms to 12 changed nothing out of season: it sits a tenth of a point below the smaller fit, with the range running either side.

pooled_signal_second_fit_vs_model_only.notes: Decisive first: full wins 300, model wins 280 on 580 decisive games. Companion to the vs-four-term cell, which is the decision-relevant comparison. SE approximated from 90pct interval width.
pooled_signal_second_fit_vs_model_only.plain_summary: The 12-term combined model beats the model alone by about 1.3 games per hundred out of season, with a wide range that runs either side.

pooled_signal_third_fit_vs_four_term.description: Third pooled fit (4 base terms + Tuesday wind-dog flag) versus the four-term unit-1 fit, LOSO 2020-2025 opener grade, paired accuracy points
pooled_signal_third_fit_vs_four_term.notes: Decisive first: full wins 4, base wins 9 on 13 decisive games. Tue-flag per-fold coefficients -0.039/-0.030/+0.113/-0.043/+0.214/-0.028 (mean +0.031, sd 0.098); full in-sample/OOS gap +1.00 vs base +0.80; OOS Brier 0.2461 vs 0.2456, logloss 0.6854 vs 0.6844 both favor base. Only 1 of 5 medium candidates was faithfully buildable (snow needs Tuesday precip that does not exist; rookie/backup depth ungateable pre-Tuesday; continuity has no pick direction). SE approximated from 90pct interval width. 5 looks.
pooled_signal_third_fit_vs_four_term.plain_summary: Adding a windy-day underdog flag to the combined model cost about a third of a point, with the range just touching the positive side.
